prompt:
### Subject/Content Brief
An illustrative diagram of a physics experiment setup. The diagram shows a straight, horizontal wire suspended from a force sensor. The wire is immersed in a uniform magnetic field that is perpendicular to its length.

### Object Relation Brief
A simple, rectangular block representing a force sensor is positioned at the top centre of the image. A straight, horizontal wire is suspended directly below it by two thin, vertical, parallel suspension wires, one at each end. The entire horizontal wire is situated within a rectangular region representing a uniform magnetic field. This magnetic field is directed into the page, indicated by a neat grid of 'X' symbols (crosses) filling the rectangular area.

### Required Labels/Annotations
None. The diagram must be purely illustrative and contain no text, letters, numbers, or symbols other than the 'X's for the magnetic field.

### Measurement Brief
No measurement arrows, scales, or dimensions are to be shown.

### Style Block
Create this image in the precise style of a TMUA / ENGAA / NSAA printed exam-paper diagram. It must be a professional, high-fidelity, monochrome vector-style illustration. Use clean, crisp, thin black line art on a plain off-white or very light grey paper background. The layout must be clean, centred, and have generous whitespace. The drawing should be simplified and schematic, not realistic. The force sensor should be a simple rectangular block, and the wire a simple straight line.

### Negative Block
Avoid all labels, text, and numbers. Do not add any arrows for current or force. Do not show any decorative elements, shading, gradients, or colours. No 3D effects. The force sensor should be a minimal block, without a screen or buttons. Ensure there are no overlapping lines or symbols.
negative_prompt: No extra labels. No overlap. No sans-serif fonts. No decorative shading. No photorealism. No colour. No exact answer-bearing measurements. No clutter. No malformed symbols. Do not place objects in the wrong support/location relationship. No text, numbers, or letters of any kind. No arrows for current or force.

must_show_relations: force sensor is above the wire
wire is suspended from the force sensor by two vertical lines
magnetic field region encloses the wire
magnetic field is perpendicular to the wire, shown by 'X' symbols

hard_constraints: force sensor must be drawn as a simple rectangle at the top
wire must be suspended from below the sensor via two thin vertical lines
magnetic field must be represented by a grid of 'X' symbols in a rectangular area around the wire
no labels of any kind are permitted on the diagram
